H2: Second-line activity is dominated by shared systematic response and vehicle-norm threshold effects, so line choice may be largely interchangeable and labels may not reflect compound-specific biology.

Target expression and dependence across A375, HA1E, HELA, HT29, MCF7, PC3, YAPC are not established here.
Repurposing Hub/MAP annotations are weaker than measured responses (S4).
L1000 activity is a vehicle-norm threshold, not viability (S5).
Shared systematic response may inflate prediction quality (S2).
Database verification supports functional descriptions, not causal proof (S3).
